verses.20:6: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ

meaning: The root ثري (thry) primarily denotes abundance, especially of wealth and possessions. It signifies being rich, opulent, or having a large amount of something.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
